description: Life insurance cash-flow skeleton for SIC 6311 retaining all 170 supplied unique US GAAP concepts once. The supplied MetLife reference guides presentation families. Insurance funding, indirect adjustments, net/gross alternatives, cash scopes and noncash disclosures remain distinct; hierarchy implies no arithmetic.
classification_notes: All 170 supplied concepts appear once. Industry inventory coverage does not establish complete reporting for an individual issuer.

The reference presentation guides broad families only. Its funds from operations, free cash flow, zeros and dashes do not establish source facts or reported calculations; no unsupported analytical subtotal is created.
Operating, investing and financing totals include discontinued operations. Continuing/discontinued subtotals are distinct scopes, not additional flows alongside inclusive totals.
Children and total node kinds prescribe no summation. Instrument, maturity, collateral, priority and ownership views overlap and require explicit reconciliation.

Indirect-method earnings adjustments are not cash proceeds/payments. Preserve source signs and inspect whether a reported gain is reversed, an expense is added back or a balance change is already cash-adjusted.
Insurance operating liabilities, reinsurance, DAC and other policyholder fund changes differ from financing annuity and contract-holder cash funding.
Investment net/gross and sale/maturity aggregates overlap detail. Policy loans, mortgages and generic notes/loans require portfolio matching and issuer activity review.
Ordinary equity-method investment returns are operating under the supplied definition; return of investment is investing. Partnership receipts may contain both types.
Cash and restricted-cash balances and FX effects retain continuing, discontinued and inclusive scopes; no automatic scope substitution or date selection is implied.
Noncash stock issuance and investment transfers, supplemental payment amounts, cross-statement revenue and unresolved activity candidates are retained separately.

All nodes use contra=false; this does not imply positive amounts. Review identifies concept-specific unresolved scope or presentation; proposed mappings still require issuer fact, dimension, unit and period checks.

metadata_contract.period_type: All 170 concepts checked against official US GAAP 2026: 167 duration and 3 instant.
metadata_contract.unit_type: All supplied concepts are monetary item types; actual currency comes from source facts.
metadata_contract.contra: False for these flow, earnings adjustment and cash-balance concepts; no universal sign reversal is prescribed.

taxonomy_reference.note: Metadata and definitions checked against official 2026 schema and documentation. Historical filings retain their own taxonomy versions and units.

sources.description: 170 unique user-supplied US GAAP concepts from the attached CF inventory.
Official FASB 2026 schema and documentation retained locally.

nodes.label: Operating activities
nodes.classification_note: Operating cash flow includes discontinued operations. Children document overlapping reconciliation families and scope alternatives; they do not define a sum.

children.label: Income starting point and operating scope
children.classification_note: Consolidated profit includes noncontrolling interests. Continuing/discontinued operating totals differ by scope; discontinued income is not a cash-flow amount.

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncomeLossFromDiscontinuedOperationsNetOfTaxAttributableToReportingEntity
concepts.review_reason: This discontinued-operation income is parent-attributable, while consolidated profit and cash flows can include noncontrolling interests; it is not itself a cash-flow amount or an automatic deduction.

children.label: Noncash and earnings adjustments
children.classification_note: Expense and gain/loss facts are retained in their reported sign convention. Reconciliation placement does not make an earnings amount a cash receipt or payment.

children.label: Depreciation, amortization and accretion
children.classification_note: Aggregates overlap standalone depreciation, residual amortization, VOBA and investment discount adjustments. Select reconciled totals or details, not their sum.

concepts.name: us-gaap:DepreciationAmortizationAndAccretionNet
concepts.review_reason: The net depreciation/amortization/accretion aggregate can include depreciation, VOBA amortization and investment accretion presented separately; reconcile its actual components.

concepts.name: us-gaap:DepreciationDepletionAndAmortization
concepts.review_reason: Depreciation, depletion and amortization overlaps depreciation and other amortization disclosures, and may be included in the broader net accretion aggregate.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OtherDepreciationAndAmortization
concepts.review_reason: Residual depreciation and amortization can be included in broader D&A or net accretion totals; verify which asset charges are excluded from the residual.

children.label: Investment discount accretion and premium amortization

concepts.name: us-gaap:AccretionAmortizationOfDiscountsAndPremiumsInvestments
concepts.review_reason: Investment accretion and amortization may already be included in the broader net depreciation/amortization/accretion adjustment; reconcile that aggregate before separate use.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OperatingLeaseRightOfUseAssetAmortizationExpense
concepts.review_reason: Operating lease ROU reduction is not a separate lease cash payment and may already be offset in lease liability or other operating changes; reconcile the indirect-method presentation.

children.label: Deferred tax adjustments
children.classification_note: Deferred expense, jurisdictional subsets and deferred-tax-plus-credit measures have different scopes. Current cash taxes are supplemental; deferred balance changes require a separate reconciliation.

children.label: Deferred income tax expense or benefit
Deferred federal or national tax expense or benefit

concepts.name: us-gaap:DeferredFederalIncomeTaxExpenseBenefit
concepts.review_reason: Federal or national deferred tax is a jurisdictional subset of continuing-operation deferred tax, not an additional adjustment alongside the full deferred-tax expense.

children.label: Deferred income taxes and tax credits

concepts.name: us-gaap:DeferredIncomeTaxesAndTaxCredits
concepts.review_reason: This deferred-tax-and-credit measure is broader than deferred tax expense alone; identify the credits and overlap with the separately supplied deferred-tax adjustments.

children.label: Share-based payment adjustments
children.classification_note: Total noncash compensation, allocated expense excluding capitalization and restricted awards overlap. Cash withholding payments are financing transactions, not compensation add-backs.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensation
concepts.review_reason: Noncash share-based compensation may include allocated award and restricted-stock expense already supplied separately; select the issuer reconciliation amount without summing overlapping disclosures.

concepts.name: us-gaap:AllocatedShareBasedCompensationExpense
concepts.review_reason: Allocated award expense excludes capitalized amounts and may overlap ShareBasedCompensation and restricted-stock expense; reconcile the issuer add-back coverage.

children.label: Restricted stock and unit noncash expense

concepts.name: us-gaap:RestrictedStockExpense
concepts.review_reason: Restricted stock or unit expense is a component of share-based compensation and may be contained in allocated award expense; avoid duplicate add-backs.

children.label: Credit loss and impairment adjustments
children.classification_note: Loan/lease/other provisions overlap narrower financing-receivable and doubtful-account provisions. Broad asset impairments may contain some of the same losses.

children.label: Loan, lease and other loss provision

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProvisionForLoanLeaseAndOtherLosses
concepts.review_reason: This broad loan, lease and other-loss provision can contain both financing-receivable and doubtful-account provisions; do not add its narrower provisions without reconciliation.

children.label: Financing receivable credit loss expense or reversal

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProvisionForLoanLossesExpensed
concepts.review_reason: Financing-receivable credit loss expense is a subset of the broader loan/lease/other-loss provision and may overlap other impairment adjustments.

children.label: Accounts receivable credit loss expense or reversal

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProvisionForDoubtfulAccounts
concepts.review_reason: Accounts-receivable credit loss expense differs from loan provisions but can be included in the broader loan/lease/other-loss total.

children.label: Investment gain and loss adjustments
children.classification_note: Realization status and instrument class form overlapping axes. Reverse only amounts included in the income starting point and use the issuer reconciliation signs.

children.label: Unrealized investment results
children.classification_note: Broad unrealized investment gains can include FV-NI equity results; neither establishes OCI treatment without source context.

concepts.name: us-gaap:UnrealizedGainLossOnInvestments
concepts.review_reason: Broad unrealized investment gains may contain FV-NI equity gains; verify earnings recognition and the included portfolios rather than reversing OCI or adding overlapping adjustments.

children.label: Unrealized FV-NI equity security gain or loss

concepts.name: us-gaap:EquitySecuritiesFvNiUnrealizedGainLoss
concepts.review_reason: The unrealized FV-NI equity result is included in the combined realized-and-unrealized FV-NI result and can overlap broad unrealized investment gains.

children.label: Combined and realized investment results
children.classification_note: FV-NI combined gains overlap unrealized equity adjustments and realized security gains; other-investment results require portfolio exclusions.

children.label: Realized and unrealized FV-NI equity security gain or loss

concepts.name: us-gaap:EquitySecuritiesFvNiGainLoss
concepts.review_reason: The FV-NI equity aggregate combines realized and unrealized results; use it instead of overlapping unrealized or broader investment-gain adjustments unless reconciled.

children.label: Realized debt and equity security gain or loss

concepts.name: us-gaap:DebtAndEquitySecuritiesRealizedGainLoss
concepts.review_reason: Realized debt-and-equity security gains may include equity sale results within FV-NI gains; reconcile instrument and realization scope before reversing earnings.

children.label: Gain or loss on disposal of other investments

concepts.name: us-gaap:GainLossOnSaleOfOtherInvestments
concepts.review_reason: Other-investment disposal gains are earnings adjustments rather than investment sale proceeds; identify the portfolio and any inclusion in a broader gain adjustment.

children.label: Embedded derivative fair-value gain or loss

concepts.name: us-gaap:EmbeddedDerivativeGainLossOnEmbeddedDerivativeNet
concepts.review_reason: Embedded derivative fair-value results can be included in insurance contract or investment adjustments; establish which earnings result is being reversed and avoid duplicate add-backs.

children.label: Disposal and debt extinguishment adjustments
children.classification_note: Business and other continuing-operation disposal gains can overlap. These and debt extinguishment earnings are separate from the related cash receipts or payments.

concepts.name: us-gaap:GainLossOnSaleOfBusiness
concepts.review_reason: A business disposal gain is an earnings item, not cash consideration; identify attribution and whether it overlaps the separately supplied continuing-operation disposal gain.

children.label: Continuing-operation disposal group gain or loss

concepts.name: us-gaap:DisposalGroupNotDiscontinuedOperationGainLossOnDisposal
concepts.review_reason: This pretax disposal gain excludes discontinued operations and can overlap the business-sale gain; reconcile the earnings adjustment rather than treating it as cash proceeds.

children.label: Equity-method operating reconciliation and returns
children.classification_note: Net-of-distributions earnings already reflect ordinary investment returns. Return of capital is classified separately in investing.

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncomeLossFromEquityMethodInvestmentsNetOfDividendsOrDistributions
concepts.review_reason: This adjustment already nets equity-method dividends or distributions other than return of investment; avoid also counting the same operating distributions as an independent receipt.

concepts.name: us-gaap:EquityMethodInvestmentDividendsOrDistributions
concepts.review_reason: The definition classifies these equity-method receipts as operating return on investment; they can already be included in the net-of-distributions earnings adjustment and exclude investing capital returns.

children.label: Unpaid policyholder interest
children.classification_note: Only the unpaid credited-interest expense is retained as an operating reconciliation item; do not equate it with cash credited or financing deposits.

children.label: Unpaid interest credited to policy owner accounts

concepts.name: us-gaap:InterestCreditedToPolicyOwnerAccount
concepts.review_reason: Only unpaid credited interest expense is covered; reconcile its inclusion in insurance or policyholder liability changes to avoid counting the same noncash accrual twice.

children.label: Residual operating reconciliation items
children.classification_note: Other noncash income/expense is narrower than the other-reconciliation-item tag, whose definition also includes operating asset/liability movements and other cash flows.

children.label: Other adjustments reconciling net income to operating cash flow

concepts.name: us-gaap:AdjustmentsToReconcileNetIncomeLossToCashProvidedByUsedInOperatingActivities
concepts.review_reason: Despite its broad name, the official definition describes other reconciliation items, not a universal total of all adjustments; determine residual exclusions before combining with identified adjustments.

children.label: Insurance operating asset and liability changes
children.classification_note: Insurance reserves, reinsurance, policyholder funds and DAC are balance-change/reconciliation concepts. Noncash changes and overlap require issuer-specific bridges.

children.label: Insurance reserve and policyholder fund changes
children.classification_note: All-insurance liabilities, future benefits plus other liabilities, standalone future reserves and other policyholder funds overlap. Financing deposits are not equivalent to these operating changes.

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInInsuranceLiabilities
concepts.review_reason: This broad insurance-liability change may contain future benefit reserves and other policyholder funds; establish the included classes and noncash exclusions.

children.label: Change in future benefit reserves and other insurance liabilities

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInFuturePolicyBenefitReservesAndOtherInsuranceLiabilities
concepts.review_reason: This combined reserve and other insurance-liability change overlaps standalone future-benefit reserves and broader insurance liabilities; select a reconciled scope.

children.label: Change in future policy benefit reserves

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInFuturePolicyBenefitReserves
concepts.review_reason: Future benefit reserve changes are included in the broader future-benefit-and-other-insurance-liability change and may also appear in the all-insurance-liability total.

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInOtherPolicyholderFunds
concepts.review_reason: This operating reconciliation change in other policyholder funds may overlap broad insurance liabilities but is not interchangeable with financing cash receipts and withdrawals.

children.label: Reinsurance recoverables, payables and funds held
children.classification_note: Recoverables are asset movements, payables reflect assumed insurance losses and funds held depend on treaty terms. Do not automatically net these different positions.

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInReinsuranceRecoverable
concepts.review_reason: The reinsurance recoverable movement concerns ceded benefit recoveries; reconcile its inclusion in net insurance changes and exclude noncash remeasurement before inferring cash.

children.label: Change in funds held under reinsurance agreements

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInFundsHeldUnderReinsuranceAgreements
concepts.review_reason: Funds held under reinsurance can include contractual and noncash balance movements; confirm asset/liability direction, issuer cash-flow section and overlap with other reinsurance changes.

children.label: DAC and premium receivable changes
children.classification_note: DAC is a capitalized acquisition-cost movement rather than an automatic cash expense; premiums receivable are distinct from insurance revenue.

children.label: Change in deferred policy acquisition costs

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInDeferredPolicyAcquisitionCosts
concepts.review_reason: The change in the DAC balance can include amortization, disposals and other noncash movements; use the issuer cash-flow reconciliation rather than treating the entire balance change as cash paid.

children.label: Other operating asset and liability changes
children.classification_note: Residual operating capital aggregates and asset/liability details overlap. No asset/liability sign inversion is imposed by this hierarchy.

children.label: Change in accrued investment income receivable
Current income tax balance changes
children.classification_note: Accrued tax payables are contained in net tax payable/receivable movements; broader movements can include deferred tax and cannot be combined without reconciliation.

children.label: Change in accrued income taxes payable

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInAccruedIncomeTaxesPayable
concepts.review_reason: Accrued income taxes payable are a liability-only view that can be included in net tax payable/receivable changes and the broader all-tax movement.

children.label: Change in income taxes payable net of receivables

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInIncomeTaxesPayableNetOfIncomeTaxesReceivable
concepts.review_reason: Net income-tax payable/receivable changes overlap accrued tax payables and can be included in the broader income-tax asset/liability movement.

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInIncomeTaxes
concepts.review_reason: This broad movement includes tax payables, receivables, deferred and other tax balances; do not add narrower current-tax changes or deferred expense without an issuer bridge.

children.label: Residual operating capital changes
children.classification_note: Net other capital can already contain separate other-asset and other-liability changes; reconcile issuer exclusions.

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInOtherOperatingCapitalNet
concepts.review_reason: This net other-operating-capital measure overlaps other operating asset and liability changes; establish its residual exclusions before using separate details.

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInOtherOperatingAssets
concepts.review_reason: Other operating asset movements can be included in the net other-operating-capital amount; establish exclusions for DAC, investment income and reinsurance assets.

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInOtherOperatingLiabilities
concepts.review_reason: Other operating liability movements can overlap the net capital amount and insurance or tax liability changes; establish residual coverage.

nodes.label: Investing activities
nodes.classification_note: Investment activity totals include discontinued operations. Instrument, maturity and net/gross views overlap; generic flows retain explicit review where classification is unresolved.

children.label: Investment acquisition and disposal flows
children.classification_note: Aggregate investment flows and asset-class or maturity views overlap. Gross receipts and payments remain separate from net measures.

children.label: Investment flow aggregates
children.classification_note: All-investment purchases and receipts overlap every included portfolio. Broad investing asset purchases can also include productive assets.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireInvestments
concepts.review_reason: All-investment purchases overlap security-class, maturity and other-investment purchase disclosures; select the aggregate or reconciled components.

children.label: Total investment sale, maturity and collection proceeds

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleMaturityAndCollectionsOfInvestments
concepts.review_reason: All-investment sale, maturity and collection proceeds include separately mapped portfolios and receipt types; do not add the aggregate to its underlying receipts.

children.label: Cash paid to acquire assets in investing activities

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireAssetsInvestingActivities
concepts.review_reason: This broad investing asset-acquisition aggregate can include investments and productive assets, so it cannot be added to investment purchases or capital expenditure components.

children.label: Available-for-sale debt cash flows
children.classification_note: Sale-and-maturity proceeds contain sale-only and maturity/prepayment/call receipts; choose the aggregate or reconciled event details.

children.label: AFS debt sale and maturity proceeds

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleAndMaturityOfAvailableForSaleSecurities
concepts.review_reason: This AFS debt aggregate includes sales, maturities, prepayments and calls; do not add it to the separate AFS sale and maturity-related receipts.

children.label: AFS debt maturities, prepayments and calls
FV-NI equity security cash flows
children.classification_note: These purchases and sale proceeds are expressly investing activities. They differ from noncash FV-NI earnings adjustments.

children.label: Trading securities held for investment
children.classification_note: These expressly exclude securities held principally for near-term resale. Sale-and-maturity proceeds overlap sale-only receipts; generic trading flows remain separate pending purpose review.

children.label: Purchases of trading securities held for investment
Sale and maturity proceeds - trading securities held for investment

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleAndMaturityOfTradingSecuritiesHeldforinvestment
concepts.review_reason: This trading-investment aggregate covers sale, maturity, repayment and call receipts and contains the separately supplied sale-only receipt.

children.label: Sale proceeds from trading securities held for investment

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfTradingSecuritiesHeldforinvestment
concepts.review_reason: Sale-only receipts from investment-held trading securities are included in the broader sale-and-maturity receipt tag; these are not short-term trading operating receipts.

children.label: Short-term investment cash flows
children.classification_note: Intended liquidation horizon and asset class overlap other investment groups. Net flows with original maturity up to three months are narrower than broad short-term investment flows.

children.label: Short-term investment payments and proceeds, net

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsForProceedsFromShortTermInvestments
concepts.review_reason: The definition restricts this net investment flow to original maturities of three months or less qualifying as investing; it is not equivalent to all short-term investment purchases and proceeds or cash equivalents.

children.label: Short-term investment sale, maturity and collection proceeds

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleMaturityAndCollectionOfShorttermInvestments
concepts.review_reason: This broad short-term receipt aggregate already covers sales, maturities, prepayments, calls and collections; reconcile it to the separately mapped sale and maturity receipts.

children.label: Short-term investment maturities, prepayments and calls
Long-term and marketable investment views
children.classification_note: Long-term is a maturity view and marketable is an instrument/liquidity view. These can overlap AFS, equity and other investment flows.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireLongtermInvestments
concepts.review_reason: Long-term investment purchases classify by intended liquidation horizon and can overlap debt/equity or marketable security purchase categories.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireMarketableSecurities
concepts.review_reason: Marketable-security purchases can overlap AFS debt, FV-NI equity and maturity-based purchase groups; establish the issuer instrument coverage.

children.label: Marketable security sale and maturity proceeds

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleAndMaturityOfMarketableSecurities
concepts.review_reason: Marketable-security sale/maturity proceeds cover HTM or AFS instruments and can include separately mapped AFS receipts; do not assume a separate portfolio.

children.label: Other investment cash flows
children.classification_note: Residual investment portfolios require exclusions for separately selected security, partnership, loan and real-estate groups.

children.label: Other investment sale and maturity proceeds

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleAndMaturityOfOtherInvestments
concepts.review_reason: Other-investment receipts combine sale and maturity events and may include partnership or other separately mapped portfolios; establish the residual population.

children.label: Policy, mortgage and other loan investment flows
children.classification_note: Generic loans and notes require portfolio and held-for-sale review. Mortgage and policy loans may be included in broader note or investment aggregates.

children.label: Policy loan cash flows
children.classification_note: Net funding/collection is an alternative to separate funding and collection. Receipts and payments must use the same policy-loan portfolio.

children.label: Policy loan payments and collections, net

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsForProceedsFromPolicyLoans
concepts.review_reason: The net policy-loan flow overlaps separate funding and collection amounts; preserve its paid-or-received sign and select a reconciled net or gross presentation.

children.label: Mortgage note cash flows
children.classification_note: Mortgage purchase payments and sale/collection receipts are investing portfolio flows; the receipt definition excludes operating collections.

children.label: Mortgage note sale and collection proceeds
Other note and loan flows
children.classification_note: Note sale/collection amounts can include generic or specialized loan portfolios. Generic loan sales/collections are candidates pending issuer classification.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireNotesReceivable
concepts.review_reason: Notes purchased may include mortgage, policy or other loans and accrued interest; determine portfolio and investing classification before combining with specialized loan flows.

children.label: Note receivable sale and collection proceeds

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfLoansReceivable
concepts.review_reason: Generic loan-sale receipts may concern held-for-sale operating assets or investment loans; verify the portfolio and issuer classification before assigning investing cash flow.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromCollectionOfLoansReceivable
concepts.review_reason: Generic loan collections can include loans also reported as mortgage, note or policy-loan collections; identify portfolio, principal scope and issuer cash-flow classification.

children.label: Real estate, partnerships and equity-method investments
children.classification_note: Real-estate joint ventures, limited partnerships and equity-method investments can describe the same interests. Distributions must distinguish return on investment from return of capital.

children.label: Investment real estate and joint ventures
children.classification_note: Combined real-estate/joint-venture purchases and receipts overlap standalone investment real-estate flows; do not add both populations.

children.label: Investment real estate and joint venture purchases

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireRealEstateAndRealEstateJointVentures
concepts.review_reason: The combined real-estate and joint-venture purchase amount overlaps standalone investment real-estate purchases and potentially partnership or equity-method investments.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireRealEstateHeldForInvestment
concepts.review_reason: Standalone real-estate investment purchases are included in the combined real-estate-and-joint-venture purchase scope where both are reported.

children.label: Investment real estate and joint venture proceeds

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromRealEstateAndRealEstateJointVentures
concepts.review_reason: Real-estate and real-estate-joint-venture receipts overlap standalone real-estate sale proceeds and may overlap equity-method disposals.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfRealEstateHeldforinvestment
concepts.review_reason: Standalone investment real-estate sale proceeds can be contained in the combined real-estate-and-joint-venture receipt amount.

children.label: Limited partnership cash flows
children.classification_note: Partnership receipts can combine sale proceeds, capital returns and earnings distributions; investing placement remains subject to the nature of the receipt.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromLimitedPartnershipInvestments
concepts.review_reason: Partnership proceeds can include distributions, capital returns and sale receipts; establish the nature and operating-versus-investing classification before using the full amount in investing.

children.label: Equity-method investment cash flows
children.classification_note: Acquisitions/advances, sale proceeds and returns of capital are investing. Ordinary return-on-investment distributions are retained in operating.

children.label: Sale of joint venture interests outside consolidation and equity method

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromDivestitureOfInterestInJointVenture
concepts.review_reason: The definition excludes interests previously consolidated or equity-method accounted; keep these joint-venture sale receipts distinct from equity-method and subsidiary disposal tags.

children.label: Business acquisitions and disposals
children.classification_note: Net acquisition payments already include acquired cash. Subsidiary interest disposals require a control assessment and are not automatically equivalent to business divestitures.

children.label: Business acquisitions, net of acquired cash
Business divestiture proceeds, net of disposed cash

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromDivestitureOfInterestInConsolidatedSubsidiaries
concepts.review_reason: Subsidiary divestitures may involve deconsolidation or sales of interests with control retained; determine control outcome and whether cash is net of disposed cash before retaining investing classification.

children.label: Productive asset cash flows
children.classification_note: PP&E purchases and productive-asset sale receipts differ from investment real estate. Broad investing asset purchases may include these same payments.

children.label: Investing derivative cash flows
children.classification_note: These tags explicitly classify non-hedging derivative cash flows as investing. Net payments/proceeds overlap gross receipts and payments.

children.label: Investing derivative payments and proceeds, net
Other investing cash flows
children.classification_note: This residual net investing flow may include transactions separately identified above; match issuer exclusions before combining.

children.label: Other investing payments and proceeds, net
Discontinued investing cash flow
children.classification_note: The investing total includes discontinued operations; the discontinued subtotal is not an additional cash flow.

nodes.label: Financing activities
nodes.classification_note: Financing cash flow includes insurance deposit funding, owners and borrowing transactions. Changes in insurance operating balances are not substitutes for financing cash flows.

children.label: Insurance contract and annuity funding
children.classification_note: Financing deposits and withdrawals differ from earned premiums and insurance operating reserve changes. Contract populations and segregated-fund presentation require issuer review.

children.label: Annuity and investment certificate funding
children.classification_note: Net flow overlaps gross receipts and repayments; use a matched population and net or gross presentation.

children.label: Annuity and investment certificate flows, net

concepts.name: us-gaap:NetChangeAnnuitiesAndInvestmentCertificates
concepts.review_reason: The net annuity and investment certificate flow overlaps gross receipts and repayments; preserve the issuer direction and do not add net and gross presentations.

children.label: Contract holder fund receipts and withdrawals
children.classification_note: Segregated fund receipts and withdrawals can overlap annuity funding. Definitions establish direction but do not prove equivalence to all policyholder funds.

concepts.name: us-gaap:AdditionsToContractHoldersFunds
concepts.review_reason: The definition specifies cash inflow to a segregated fund account; verify the issuer financing presentation and overlap with annuity deposits or policyholder funding.

concepts.name: us-gaap:WithdrawalFromContractHoldersFunds
concepts.review_reason: The definition specifies cash outflow from a segregated fund account; reconcile its financing classification and overlap with annuity repayments or contract holder funding.

children.label: Debt financing cash flows
children.classification_note: Maturity, collateral and priority are overlapping debt classification axes. Combined and net amounts are alternatives to matching component flows, not additive totals.

children.label: Aggregate debt proceeds and repayments
children.classification_note: Aggregate debt proceeds include short- and long-term borrowing. Debt repayments exclude lease obligations; lease principal is separately mapped.

concepts.name: us-gaap:RepaymentsOfDebt
concepts.review_reason: Total debt repayments include short- and long-term debt but exclude lease obligations; do not add maturity, secured or senior repayment views to this aggregate.

children.label: Long-term debt proceeds and repayments
children.classification_note: Other long-term debt is a subset of long-term debt and can overlap other-debt flows. Net and gross amounts require matched coverage.

children.label: Other long-term debt proceeds and repayments, net

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfOtherLongTermDebt
concepts.review_reason: Net other-long-term borrowing flows overlap gross other debt proceeds and other-long-term repayments; match the same debt population before reconciliation.

concepts.name: us-gaap:RepaymentsOfOtherLongTermDebt
concepts.review_reason: Other long-term repayments overlap other debt and long-term debt totals as well as the supplied net other-long-term flow.

children.label: Short-term debt flows
children.classification_note: Net short-term borrowing and the original-maturity-up-to-three-month subset overlap. Gross repayments must not be added to net borrowings.

children.label: Short-term debt proceeds and repayments, net

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfShortTermDebt
concepts.review_reason: The net short-term borrowing flow overlaps gross repayments and the narrower three-month-or-less net borrowing measure; match original maturity and issuer netting.

children.label: Debt proceeds and repayments - maturities up to three months

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfShortTermDebtMaturingInThreeMonthsOrLess
concepts.review_reason: Net borrowings with initial maturity of three months or less are a subset of broader net short-term borrowing flows; avoid adding both.

concepts.name: us-gaap:RepaymentsOfShortTermDebt
concepts.review_reason: Gross short-term debt repayments overlap net short-term borrowing flows; do not combine net and gross presentations without matched proceeds.

children.label: Other, secured and senior debt views
children.classification_note: Other debt may overlap other long-term debt; secured and senior repayments can refer to the same long-term instruments.

concepts.name: us-gaap:RepaymentsOfOtherDebt
concepts.review_reason: Other-debt repayments can include other long-term debt; establish residual debt classes before using both tags.

concepts.name: us-gaap:RepaymentsOfSecuredDebt
concepts.review_reason: Secured repayments describe long-term debt by collateral and exclude tax-exempt secured debt; they can overlap long-term and senior repayments.

concepts.name: us-gaap:RepaymentsOfSeniorDebt
concepts.review_reason: Senior long-term debt repayments classify by priority and may overlap secured, total long-term and all-debt repayment views.

children.label: Repurchase agreements and finance leases
children.classification_note: Repo funding is distinct from security sale proceeds. Finance-lease principal is excluded from the supplied all-debt repayment total.

children.label: Repurchase agreement proceeds and payments, net
Debt issuance cost payments
children.classification_note: Cash costs of originating debt differ from amortization expense and reduce cash separately from gross borrowing proceeds.

children.label: Equity issuance, repurchases and owner contributions
children.classification_note: Owner, instrument and transaction views overlap; no aggregate or related-party flow is automatically additive to a stock issuance amount.

children.label: Equity issuance receipts
children.classification_note: Common/preferred issuance, treasury reissuance and option exercise receipts can overlap issuer issuance totals; identify transaction coverage.

children.label: Equity repurchase payments
children.classification_note: All-equity repurchases include common and preferred repurchases; callable preferred is an overlapping preferred-instrument subset.

children.label: Total common and preferred stock repurchases

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsForRepurchaseOfEquity
concepts.review_reason: Combined common and preferred repurchases contain the separate common/preferred tags and may overlap redeemable preferred repurchases.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsForRepurchaseOfRedeemablePreferredStock
concepts.review_reason: Callable preferred stock reacquisitions can overlap preferred and all-equity repurchases; establish the instrument population before combining.

children.label: Related-owner contributions
children.classification_note: Parent contributions are a subset of related-owner funding and may be included in common stock proceeds; reconcile legal-entity and owner scope.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromContributionsFromAffiliates
concepts.review_reason: Affiliate contributions may include amounts from the parent or other related owners; identify contributor and overlap with stock issuance before including separate financing receipts.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromContributionsFromParent
concepts.review_reason: Parent contributions recorded in additional paid-in capital can be included in affiliate contributions or common-stock proceeds; reconcile owner and legal-entity scope.

children.label: Noncontrolling ownership transactions
children.classification_note: Net noncontrolling receipts/payments exclude dividends and overlap separate gross ownership receipts and payments. Control-retaining ownership transactions are distinct from deconsolidation.

children.label: Noncontrolling interest proceeds and payments, net

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromPaymentsToMinorityShareholders
concepts.review_reason: This net noncontrolling ownership flow excludes dividends and overlaps separate noncontrolling receipts and payments; use a matched net or gross presentation.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromMinorityShareholders
concepts.review_reason: Noncontrolling funding receipts overlap the net noncontrolling ownership flow; they exclude the separately classified dividend presentation only when reconciled to issuer disclosures.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsToMinorityShareholders
concepts.review_reason: These payments reduce noncontrolling ownership and exclude dividends; do not combine gross payments with the net noncontrolling ownership flow.

children.label: Share award tax withholding
children.classification_note: Cash paid to meet grantee withholding obligations is financing and differs from noncash share-based compensation expense.

children.label: Dividends and owner distributions
children.classification_note: All dividends/capital distributions and ordinary-dividend totals overlap common, preferred and noncontrolling dividends. Affiliate distributions may overlap owner payments.

children.label: Distribution total alternatives
children.classification_note: Ordinary dividends exclude capital distributions included in the broader dividend/distribution definition; both include noncontrolling recipients.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsOfDividends
concepts.review_reason: This cash distribution aggregate includes capital distributions and noncontrolling interests as well as common and preferred dividends; reconcile its scope to ordinary dividends and ownership payments.

children.label: Ordinary dividends paid, including noncontrolling interests

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsOfOrdinaryDividends
concepts.review_reason: Ordinary dividends include common, preferred and noncontrolling recipients, while PaymentsOfDividends can also include capital distributions; reconcile alternative totals.

children.label: Dividends by recipient
children.classification_note: Common and preferred dividends concern parent shareholders; noncontrolling dividends concern subsidiary owners. Match aggregate attribution before reconciliation.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsOfDistributionsToAffiliates
concepts.review_reason: Affiliate earnings distributions can overlap dividends or ownership payments; verify recipient relationship and the scope of selected distribution totals.

children.label: Other financing cash flows
children.classification_note: Non-hedging derivative financing, financing contingent consideration and residual financing flows are retained separately; residual totals may already include identified transactions.

children.label: Financing derivative payments and proceeds, net
Contingent consideration paid in financing activities
Other financing proceeds and payments, net
Discontinued financing cash flow
children.classification_note: The total financing cash flow includes discontinued operations; this subtotal is not an additional flow.

nodes.label: Cash changes, FX and balances
nodes.classification_note: Use matching continuing/discontinued and restricted-cash scopes. Instant balances are observations at dates, not separate beginning/end concepts or duration cash flows.

children.label: Cash change measures
children.classification_note: Both supplied cash-change measures include discontinued operations and differ only by inclusion of FX. They are alternatives, not additive changes.

children.label: Change in total cash and restricted cash including FX
Change in total cash and restricted cash excluding FX
FX effects by cash scope
children.classification_note: The inclusive FX total overlaps continuing and discontinued components. Only matching-scope FX effects can reconcile changes with and without FX.

children.label: FX effect on cash - including discontinued operations
FX effect on cash - continuing operations
FX effect on cash - discontinued operations
Cash balances by scope
children.classification_note: The inclusive cash/restricted-cash balance overlaps continuing and discontinued balances. Date selection supplies beginning and ending values; missing data is not zero.

children.label: Cash and restricted cash - including discontinued operations
Cash and restricted cash - continuing operations
Cash and restricted cash - discontinued operations

nodes.label: Supplementary disclosures
nodes.classification_note: Cash payment disclosures already included in operating CF, noncash transfers, balance movements and unresolved activity classifications are retained outside primary flow families.

children.label: Supplemental cash payments
children.classification_note: Tax payments net refunds and operating interest paid excluding capitalized interest are supplemental details, not additional deductions from operating CF.

children.label: Income taxes paid, net of refunds
Operating interest paid, excluding capitalized interest
Noncash transactions
children.classification_note: Stock issued at fair value and investments received through transfers are expressly noncash. Neither is a cash financing receipt or investment payment.

children.label: Acquisition cash detail
children.classification_note: Acquired cash is part of net acquisition consideration and must not be added again to the net acquisition payment.

concepts.name: us-gaap:CashAcquiredFromAcquisition
concepts.review_reason: Acquired cash is already reflected in acquisitions net of cash acquired; this disclosure must not be added again as an independent investing receipt.

children.label: Other balance and revenue disclosures
children.classification_note: Deferred-tax balance changes, DAC disposals and insurance services revenue do not establish independent cash flows or reconciliation adjustments.

children.label: Change in deferred income tax balances

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInDeferredIncomeTaxes
concepts.review_reason: The deferred-tax balance movement can include OCI, acquisitions and other non-earnings changes; it is not interchangeable with deferred tax expense in the operating reconciliation.

children.label: DAC disposed or classified as held for sale

concepts.name: us-gaap:DeferredPolicyAcquisitionCostsDisposition
concepts.review_reason: DAC disposed or classified as held for sale is an asset movement, not amortization or a cash acquisition/disposal payment; no separate cash effect is inferred.

concepts.name: us-gaap:InsuranceServicesRevenue
concepts.review_reason: Insurance services revenue combines earned premiums and fees with other earnings items; it is not cash collected and cannot be used as an operating receipt or noncash add-back without a cash-conversion reconciliation.

children.label: Flows and movements requiring activity review
children.classification_note: Generic trading, deposits and collateral movements require issuer context. This group deliberately assigns no operating, investing or financing activity.

children.label: Trading security proceeds and payments, net

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromPaymentsForTradingSecurities
concepts.review_reason: The generic trading-security net flow does not establish whether securities are held for near-term sale or investment; issuer purpose and presentation must determine operating or investing classification.

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInCollateralHeldUnderSecuritiesLending
concepts.review_reason: Securities-lending collateral changes include investments and unrealized value changes as well as cash; the carrying-value movement cannot be assumed to be a financing cash flow.

children.label: Change in derivative cash collateral from counterparties

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseCashCollateralFromCounterparties
concepts.review_reason: The derivative cash-collateral balance change can combine collateral held and posted; verify netting, actual cash movement and issuer section before classification.

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInDeposits
concepts.review_reason: The deposit balance movement does not by itself distinguish customer funding from asset deposits or noncash changes; establish the balance nature and cash-flow section.
